activity.text: Lead captured from Channel Partner — Realty Junction (Sandeep Gupta).
Inbound call. Looking for a 3 BHK in Hingna Road, possession before Mar 2028. Budget around ₹78 L.
Sent project brochure & price list for Abhiman Niwas Tower B.
Site visit completed — Tower B, Floor 7, Unit 704. Liked east-facing balcony, asked about 705.
Internal note: lead is comparing with Shradha Pinnacle. Push possession date as differentiator.
Discussed pricing for 705. Customer asked for 3% discount + free covered parking.
Sent revised cost sheet — 2.5% negotiated discount, two parking slots included.

visits.notes: Tower B unit 705 walk-through. Bringing wife and CA. Pickup from Sitabuldi 11:00.
